comment: The research librarian helped me find databases for my senior design project, and that support saved me a lot of time.
The collections are strong, but access to several journals is confusing and links break too often.
Study rooms are valuable, but the noise near the quiet area makes it hard to focus in the evening.
Instruction sessions are excellent. Students leave with practical search strategies and more confidence.
Printing is frustrating because the computers are slow and the payment process is unclear.
Library staff are friendly and knowledgeable, especially when helping with course reserves.
